contexts.text: Every clean beast () = good affections.
Unless the internal be clean and pure...
The rites of the Church signified, here, the cleanness of external worship, which is clean when there is what is internal in the external...
In the Original Language, blamelessness is expressed by a word which also means cleanness and purity.
Clothed in fine linen, white and clean () = the same in love and thence faith.
The fear of Jehovah is clean () = love.
Such things are removed when man is cleansed, that is, when he is being regenerated.
Cleansings in the Ancient Church.
That to he cleansed = to he sanctified, is evident from the cleansings which have been commanded.
To sprinkle clean waters () = the purification of the heart; thus to he cleansed = to be sanctified.
Blood used in cleansings. Illustrated.
Cleansings from impure things are effected through the truths of faith. Illustrate. Explained.
Why he who was wholly leprous from head to foot was clean ().
As hyssop has this signification, it was used in cleansings, which signified purifications from falsities and evils. Illustrated.
The Church will be established with such... for those are called lepers who are unclean, yet long to be cleansed.
To cleanse the land seven months () = the plenary restoration of good and truth in the Church.
It is according to the appearance... that it is said in the Word, that man is clean from sins.
As the substance of heaven as to cleanness () = the translucence of the Angelic Heaven.
To be cleansed from truth profaned and falsified is to be withdrawn through the truths and goods of the Word.
The mercy-seat = cleansing from evils, or the remission of sins, consequently, the hearing and reception of all the things of worship. Explained.
A clean heart () = a will averse to evils, which are unclean.
Thou shalt cleanse from sin upon the altar () = purification from evils in Heaven, and in the Church. To cleanse = to purify.
That the outside may be clean also () = that thus the exteriors are purified.
These are they who are called clean in heart ().
The conjunction of the Lord with the man with whom evils have been removed is meant by, the clean in heart shall see God.
Those who have cleansed their religious principles from the evils of falsity. Signified.
To wash = to cleanse one's self from evils and falsities. Illustrated.
Fine linen clean and resplendent () = shining from good and pure from truths... Clean = that which is free from evil, thus that which shines from good.
To the clean all things are clean, and to the unclean all things are unclean.
The uncleanness of Hell is from scortatory love, and the cleanness of Heaven is from marriage love. Explained.
The air was cleansed.
To bury them, and cleanse the land () = to destroy them all, and completely clear the Church of them.
To create a clean heart () = to reform as to the good of love.
He that hath clean hands () = those who are in truths from faith; and pure in heart = those who are in good from love.
The cleansing of the Jews () = purification from sins, thus all things of the Jewish Church, for the Church regards purification from sins as its all.
He who is washed = him who is interiorly clean; needeth not save to wash his feet = that then he is exteriorly cleansed; but is clean every whit ().
Divine truth is called clean (), from the fact that it is genuine.
All clean things come forth from the truths which are from good.
